response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, tr.tradekind AS tradekind, s.optvolrt AS optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS ov FROM joined), pairs AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM joined GROUP BY transref, tradekind), dev AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_opt, ABS(p.avg_opt - o.ov) AS deviation FROM pairs p JOIN overall o ON o.ov IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev d WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_opt, deviation, deviation - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_opt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind
